title: Word Counter Tool: Count Words, Characters and Density in Real Time
description: Free word counter tool to count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs in real time, with keyword density analysis. Private, in your browser, no uploads.

sections.heading: Why Writers Ruthlessly Count Words
paragraphs: Word counts are contract clauses: blog posts have SEO targets, academic essays enforce limits, social captions cap characters, and online forms reject too-long answers. A reliable word counter is the guardrail that keeps every submission within bounds.
Counting by hand is impossible; trusty tools should also reveal structure — sentences, paragraphs and reading time.
ChooseTools counts in real time as you type or paste, running entirely in your browser with no upload.
Content teams use word counts to maintain editorial consistency across publications, ensuring that no article drifts far above or below the expected length.

sections.heading: Words, Characters With and Without Spaces, Sentences, Paragraphs
paragraphs: Different platforms count differently: databases often count words, forms count characters, and studies count characters without spaces.
The counter presents words, characters (both variants), sentences and paragraphs at once, so you never estimate.
Watch every metric update live with each keystroke.
Character count without spaces is especially important for coding challenges, patent filings and airline baggage tags where every character carries a cost.

sections.heading: Keyword Density: The SEO Counter You Did Not Know You Needed
paragraphs: Overusing a keyword triggers spam filters; underusing it misses your target. Density analysis shows how often each word recurs.
Spin through results to check your primary keyword hits plausible range.
This turns a blunt counter into an optimization instrument.
SEO professionals typically aim for a primary keyword density between one and two percent, and the density display makes it trivial to verify the target.

sections.heading: Writing Goals: from 300 to 4000 Words
paragraphs: Blogs, theses, product copy and press releases each live in a word band. The counter gives immediate feedback toward your target lane.
Progressing from draft to final, metric changes guide trimming and expanding with precision.
Every blank flash of progress is feedback.
Academic writers preparing abstracts with strict limits can watch the sentence count rise in real time and stop before exceeding the journal requirement.

sections.heading: Reading Time and Complexity Estimates
paragraphs: Beyond raw counts, the tool estimates reading time based on average adult speed, helping editors schedule content for newsletters and presentations.
Sentence length averages hint at readability: shorter sentences improve comprehension for general audiences while longer ones suit academic prose.
These supplementary metrics give writers a fuller picture of their text than a simple word count alone.

sections.heading: Detecting Over-Long Sentences and Readability Issues
paragraphs: When average sentence length exceeds twenty-five words, most readability formulas flag the text as difficult for general audiences.
Writers can scan the sentence count alongside word count to identify paragraphs that need splitting for clarity.
Pairing count data with a manual readability review produces content that is both metric-compliant and genuinely easy to read.

sections.heading: Private Counting of Everything You Write
paragraphs: Essays and client work never leave your machine — the metric engine runs locally.
No upload, no banner ads selling your words, no account.
On Windows, macOS, Linux or a phone, identical behavior.
Legal briefs, medical manuscripts and proprietary product descriptions remain confidential when the counting utility operates entirely within the browser.

sections.heading: Meeting Submission Deadlines With Live Limits
paragraphs: Many application portals state a hard character ceiling, and exceeding it by a single character triggers an automatic rejection.
Typing directly into a live counter lets you stop exactly at the limit, avoiding the round of trimming that becomes necessary when a paste-and-check tool is used after the fact.
For essay prompts with both minimum and maximum bounds, a live counter keeps the draft inside the acceptable window throughout the writing session.

sections.heading: Count, Then Polish With Companion Tools
paragraphs: When a passage runs over, trim with case tools, deduplicate with line dedupe, or reformat with placeholder generation for mockups.
The full suite is free and browser-based.
Every word — counted, controlled, delivered.
Writers who combine a word counter with a text-diff tool can track exactly which sentences were added or removed between drafts.

faqs.q: Does the counter update in real time as I type?
faqs.a: Yes. Word, character, sentence and paragraph counts update instantly with each keystroke, with character counts both with and without spaces.

faqs.q: Can the tool measure keyword density?
faqs.a: Yes. It analyzes how often each word occurs in your text, helping you find natural keyword weight for SEO or style work.
Yes. Everything runs locally in your browser — your text is never uploaded anywhere.
Yes. The tool calculates approximate reading time based on standard adult reading speed, giving editors a quick scheduling reference.

faqs.q: Can I count words in multiple languages?
faqs.a: Yes. The counter splits on whitespace and works for text in virtually any language that uses ordinary spacing, including accented and non-Latin scripts.

faqs.q: Can I paste a whole document and count it?
faqs.a: Yes. Pasting a full document updates all metrics at once, giving immediate totals for any length of text.
